coverage.scope: Current-master WovenBackend unit, registered-handler and loopback HTTP tests. Generated Migrations/**/*.cs excluded by existing policy; all other application sources included. No archived-binary union.

methods: Meaningful response, persisted state and recipient/signal assertions; controlled provider/cache doubles. Loopback host exercises real JWT/auth middleware with explicit test configuration, not full Program startup.
limitations: 80% backend line and branch target remains unfinished.
EF InMemory does not prove PostgreSQL constraints, SQL translation, transactional concurrency, or deletion integrity.
No account-deletion success claim; #165 and fresh migrations #111/#144 remain separate obligations.
Cookie/CSRF/CORS, banned/deleted tokens, realtime, provider behavior and full Program wiring not certified by these tests.
Frontend remeasurement and gaps remain queued after backend priority.
No sandbox/persona campaign, paid calls, deployment or application edits.
